channels.label: Install script
channels.what: Downloads the latest release from GitHub, checks its SHA-256 (and its cosign signature when cosign is installed), and installs sievant into ~/.local/bin. Run it again to upgrade.

verify.text: The script verifies the release before installing anything. To check the script itself, compare its SHA-256 with the one published on the install page.

channels.label: PowerShell
channels.what: The same steps on Windows PowerShell 5.1 or PowerShell 7; installs sievant.exe into your user profile.

verify.text: The script verifies the release before installing anything. To check the script itself, compare its SHA-256 with the one published on the install page.

channels.label: Homebrew
channels.what: Installs the Sievant cask from the rajasatyajit tap. The macOS binary is not notarized by Apple: the guarantee is the checksum and the cosign signature.

verify.text: Check that checksums.txt was signed by the repository’s release workflow on a version tag, then compare your download’s SHA-256 with its line in checksums.txt.
commands: TAG={tag}   # the version you installed: sievant version

channels.label: Scoop
channels.what: Adds the rajasatyajit bucket, then installs.

verify.text: Check that checksums.txt was signed by the repository’s release workflow on a version tag, then compare your download’s SHA-256 with its line in checksums.txt.
commands: TAG={tag}   # the version you installed: sievant version

channels.label: winget
channels.what: Installs from the winget community repository, which can show a new version later than GitHub while Microsoft reviews it.

verify.text: Check that checksums.txt was signed by the repository’s release workflow on a version tag, then compare your download’s SHA-256 with its line in checksums.txt.
commands: TAG={tag}   # the version you installed: sievant version

channels.label: apt
commands: sudo apt update && sudo apt install sievant
channels.what: Adds the signed apt repository, so apt installs and updates sievant.

verify.text: The repository metadata and every package are signed with the OpenPGP key halotrcer-packages.asc (fingerprint D2D9 6618 831A C55B 81E2 4DA3 039B 5DA0 D3E3 9071).

channels.label: dnf / yum
channels.what: Adds the signed yum repository for Fedora, RHEL and Amazon Linux; dnf offers to import the key on first use.

verify.text: The repository metadata and every package are signed with the OpenPGP key halotrcer-packages.asc (fingerprint D2D9 6618 831A C55B 81E2 4DA3 039B 5DA0 D3E3 9071).

channels.label: apk
channels.what: Installs the apk signing key once, then a signed package from the release (Alpine).

verify.text: With the key installed, apk verifies the package without --allow-untrusted.

channels.label: Docker
channels.what: Runs the distroless, non-root image for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.

verify.text: Each image is cosign-signed by the same release workflow.

channels.label: Helm
commands:
helm install sievant oci://ghcr.io/rajasatyajit/charts/sievant --version {version} \
  --namespace sievant --create-namespace -f values.yaml
channels.what: Installs the chart into Kubernetes, for gateway or sidecar mode. Its default image is the release’s, pinned by digest.

verify.text: The chart is cosign-signed by the release workflow and carries a SLSA build provenance attestation.

channels.label: GitHub Releases
channels.what: Download the archive for your platform and checksums.txt from the release page.

verify.text: Check that checksums.txt was signed by the repository’s release workflow on a version tag, then compare your download’s SHA-256 with its line in checksums.txt.
commands: TAG={tag}   # the version you installed: sievant version

channels.label: Air-gapped
channels.what: One bundle per platform with the archive, SBOM, packages, checksums and signatures. Carry it across, then check it with a Sievant you already trust before installing.

verify.text: sievant verify reads only: every file must be the one checksums.txt names, byte for byte, and with cosign installed it checks the signature first.
